verification_targets.description: Overall X extent (width) of the final L-bracket bounding box.

functional_requirements: L-bracket shall provide a stable horizontal base and a vertical mounting face.
Single through-hole shall be used for mounting or fastening and shall be 6 mm in diameter as specified.
Part shall be manufacturable as one connected solid, preferably with the base on the build plate for FDM printing.
No thread, counterbore, countersink, or additional holes are specified.
special_features: The part MUST be an L-bracket with a horizontal base leg and a vertical leg joined at 90 degrees, both THICKNESS mm thick, overall width OVERALL_WIDTH_X and overall height OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z.
The vertical leg MUST be located at the rear edge of the base, with VERTICAL_FACE_OUTER_Y = BASE_LENGTH_Y/2 and VERTICAL_FACE_INNER_Y = VERTICAL_FACE_OUTER_Y - THICKNESS.
The horizontal base leg MUST extend from Y = -BASE_LENGTH_Y/2 to Y = +BASE_LENGTH_Y/2 and have thickness BASE_THICKNESS_Z = THICKNESS.
The vertical leg MUST be planar and perpendicular to the horizontal base, with its top edge at Z = OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z.
The through-hole MUST be a single circular hole of diameter HOLE_DIAMETER, centered on the vertical face at X = HOLE_CENTER_X and Z = HOLE_CENTER_Z = OVERALL_HEIGHT_Z - HOLE_FROM_TOP_Z.
The through-hole MUST penetrate the vertical leg along the Y axis, from VERTICAL_FACE_OUTER_Y to VERTICAL_FACE_INNER_Y, not along X or Z.
The part MUST be symmetric about the YZ plane (X=0), with the through-hole centered at X = 0.
The through-hole MUST remain clear of the horizontal base leg, satisfying HOLE_CENTER_Z - HOLE_RADIUS > BASE_THICKNESS_Z.
MUST NOT add extra flanges, ribs, counterbores, countersinks, fillets, chamfers, or additional holes unless explicitly requested.
